name: Huda Fold
summary: An open Quran becomes one calm, sweeping mark, with a pointed arch held in its central fold.
why: The pages and arch are one silhouette. Both leaves use mirrored curves around x=54; the fold stays on that axis. A brass page turn follows the same lower contour and meets the central fold exactly, so the accent is part of the book rather than an attached symbol.
risk: The Quran is expressed through the open-book silhouette and Islamic arch, without lettering. The small arch simplifies at 24px.
sub1: The opening belongs to the book itself
sub2: Shared curves keep the shape quiet and balanced
theme: Quran as a place of guidance
reasonToChoose: A simple book identity whose Islamic character comes from its own negative space.
